opening.narration: Breaking news. Earth has officially hit 451 degrees. The oceans are a hot tub. Lake Lag has boiled, which is impressive, because it was already empty. The Moon is now the only place with decent weather. Good luck, and stay hydrated.
opening.video_prompt: Waking up in a cramped Stanford dorm room, blinding orange sunlight through the blinds, posters curling off the walls from the heat, a small TV on the desk flashing red breaking-news graphics, the air shimmering.
opening.audio_prompt: Muffled TV newscaster, distant sirens, a rattling struggling air conditioner.

roommate.narration: Your roommate is asleep through the apocalypse.
roommate.video_prompt: The camera turns to the other bed: a roommate sprawled and snoring under a wobbling desk fan, sweat-soaked pillow, sunlight blazing across the blanket.
roommate.audio_prompt: Loud snoring, a wobbling desk fan, distant sirens.

choices.label: Wake him up
choices.outcome_narration: He jolts awake, grabs a backpack, and is somehow out the door before you.
choices.outcome_video_prompt: The roommate jolts upright, grabs a backpack and sprints out the dorm door ahead of the camera, papers flying.

choices.label: Leave him
choices.outcome_narration: You save time. He keeps snoring. You'll probably never see him again.
choices.outcome_video_prompt: The camera backs out of the dorm room, the roommate still snoring under the fan, and the door swings shut.
